result.question: How long is the graduate permission for a level 9 masters degree
result.answer:
Graduates with an award at Level 9 or above on the National Framework of Qualifications who qualify for the Programme will be granted permission for 12 months initially. This can be renewed for a further period of twelve months, subject to certain conditions [1]. 

For those who have completed a master’s degree programme, a further 12 months can be provided subject to conditions [5].

case.question: What does Stamp 1G allow me to do

result.question: What does Stamp 1G allow me to do
result.answer: Stamp 1G allows you to look for employment in Ireland under the Third Level Graduate Programme, subject to conditions [1]. You can work full-time, but are not permitted to operate a business or be self-employed. If your Stamp 1G expires, you must find a job that requires an employment permit and follow the usual application process with the Department of Enterprise Trade and Employment [1].
uncited: You can work full-time, but are not permitted to operate a business or be self-employed.

case.question: What is Stamp 0

result.question: What is Stamp 0
result.answer: Stamp 0 indicates that you have permission to reside in the State, confirming that you obey the laws of the State, should not become involved in criminal activity, and are continuously resident in the State for the duration of your permission [2][3]. It can be used by dependent adult relatives, retirees, visiting academics, or others who meet specific criteria [2].

case.question: Can I work full time during the summer holidays on Stamp 2

result.question: Can I work full time during the summer holidays on Stamp 2
result.answer:
According to [3], you can work in casual employment for a maximum of 40 hours per week during holidays. However, it does not specify that this is limited to part-time work only. Therefore, it implies that you can work full-time during the summer holidays on Stamp 2.

case.question: What documents do I need to bring to my first registration appointment

result.question: What documents do I need to bring to my first registration appointment
result.answer:
For a first-time registration, you will need to provide original documents including private medical insurance with the required cover, if applicable [1]. You will also need proof of address and your corresponding entry visa to the permission you wish to register [1]. If your permission requires preclearance, the corresponding preclearance application must have been approved prior to entry for the permission you wish to register [1]. Additionally, if your permission is dependent on another individual as a primary sponsor, this person must attend your registration appointment with you [1].

You can find a full list of required documents depending on the type of permission being registered in the "Required Documents" section [3] or by following the instructions in FAQ 2 [4].

case.question: How do I renew my IRP card

result.question: How do I renew my IRP card
result.answer:
To renew your IRP card, you must apply online through the ISD's online renewal portal. You will need a copy of your most recent IRP card and the biometric page of your current passport [2]. If you are not currently in possession of your IRP card, you will be required to include an explanation why [2].

You can apply to renew from 12 weeks prior to expiry of your current IRP [1] or as soon as possible if you have recently received a new stamp category [3]. Note that Stamp 2 applicants (students) must wait until their course starts before applying to renew [1][4].

case.question: How much does the Critical Skills Employment Permit cost

result.question: How much does the Critical Skills Employment Permit cost
result.answer: The processing fee for a Critical Skills Employment Permit is €1,000. If an application is unsuccessful, 90% of the fee will be refunded [1]. The fee may be paid by a third party, but refunds are restricted to applicants only [1].

case.question: What is the minimum salary for a critical skills permit if I graduated recently

result.question: What is the minimum salary for a critical skills permit if I graduated recently
result.answer: If you have received your qualification within the 12 month period prior to the date of application for the employment permit, the minimum annual remuneration will be €36,848 [2].

case.question: How long do I have to stay with my first employer on a critical skills permit

result.question: How long do I have to stay with my first employer on a critical skills permit
result.answer:
You must stay with your initial employer for a minimum period of 9 months [1]. If you leave before this, you may not be eligible for a new Critical Skills Employment Permit if less than 9 months has elapsed since the permit holder first commenced employment in the State [1].

However, if you are made redundant, you have up to 6 months from the date of dismissal to seek alternative employment and can apply for a new permit [2].

case.question: What happens if I am made redundant while on a critical skills permit

result.question: What happens if I am made redundant while on a critical skills permit
result.answer: If you are made redundant while on a Critical Skills Employment Permit, you must notify the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment within 4 weeks of your dismissal. You will then have up to 6 months from the date of dismissal to seek alternative employment [1][2]. If you obtain a new job offer with the same job title, you can still apply for a Critical Skills Employment Permit [2][3].
uncited: If you are made redundant while on a Critical Skills Employment Permit, you must notify the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment within 4 weeks of your dismissal.

case.question: When can I move from Stamp 1 to Stamp 4 with a critical skills permit

result.question: When can I move from Stamp 1 to Stamp 4 with a critical skills permit
result.answer:
You may be eligible for a Stamp 4 permission upon completion of 21 months from commencement of employment in the State on the basis of a Critical Skills Employment Permit [5]. Commencement of employment is determined via an ‘Employment Detail Summary’, available on revenue.ie/myaccount [4].

Note: The sources do not specify exactly when you can move to Stamp 4, but rather after completing 21 months.

case.question: Can my spouse work in Ireland if I hold a critical skills permit

result.question: Can my spouse work in Ireland if I hold a critical skills permit
result.answer:
Yes, your spouse can seek any employment once they are resident in the State. They will be eligible to apply for a Dependant/Partner/Spouse Employment Permit, which is currently issued free of charge [1]. 

Note that this permit allows them to work without needing an employment permit, but it's still subject to certain conditions and requirements [4].

case.question: How soon after arriving in Ireland do I have to register my permission

result.question: How soon after arriving in Ireland do I have to register my permission
result.answer: You must register your immigration permission within 90 days of arrival in Ireland [1]. Your passport will be endorsed with a landing stamp instructing that you register with Immigration Service Delivery within this time frame [2][4]. As soon as you arrive, create an account on the Customer Service Portal and book an appointment [2][4].
